input.quote: 1.4 HDI shall provide the Company with access to, and
input.rationale: The only inbound grant to us is Section 1.4 (access to and right to use HDI's hosting system, software and Content administration tools); Section 6.1 is an outbound Marks licence to HDI and is not responsive. Section 1.4 says nothing about our affiliates or contractors, and while it is not expressly revocable at will, it fails the fallback because affiliates are not covered even on written notice; Section 10.3's successors-and-assigns clause does not clearly make the use rights transferable in an M&A transaction. We therefore added a single sentence at the fallback level extending the Section 1.4 rights to our affiliates on written notice and permitting transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition, leaving the rest of Section 1.4 untouched.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

ops.text: The access and right to use granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 shall extend to the Company's affiliates upon written notice to HDI, and may be transferred by the Company to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates upon written notice to HDI and made them transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition, which is our fallback licence-scope position.
proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to Company affiliates on written notice and make them transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
